headline: SIMULATION: Bushfire Emergency Warning near Williamstown in the Adelaide Hills on a Catastrophic fire danger day.
summary: THIS IS A SIMULATION - NOTHING HAS HAPPENED. In this scenario, a bushfire is burning out of control near Williamstown and Mount Crawford Forest on a Catastrophic fire danger day, with a CFS Emergency Warning in place. Power is off to about 2,000 homes and roads around the fire are closed. Follow CFS advice on alert.sa.gov.au and ABC Radio Adelaide 891 AM.
actions: Follow CFS advice on alert.sa.gov.au and ABC 891 AM
If you are near the fire, act on your bushfire plan now
Keep away from the Hills and keep roads clear

confirmed.title: SIMULATION: Bushfire Emergency Warning - Williamstown
confirmed.impact: Simulated: homes under threat; evacuations around Williamstown and Kersbrook; roads closed; power off to ~2,000 homes.

concerns.title: SIMULATION: Bushfire at Williamstown (Adelaide Hills)
drivers: SIMULATED: CFS Emergency Warning for a bushfire near Williamstown and Mount Crawford Forest, moving south-east towards Kersbrook.
Catastrophic fire danger in the Mount Lofty Ranges with hot north-westerly winds; a south-westerly change is expected this evening.
Roads around Williamstown closed; power off to about 2,000 homes.

scenarios.name: Fire contained before the wind change
scenarios.sa_impact: Smoke over the northern suburbs; Hills roads closed for the day.

scenarios.name: Wind change pushes fire towards Kersbrook and Mount Pleasant
scenarios.sa_impact: Evacuations in more Hills towns; wider power cuts; heavy smoke across Adelaide.

scenarios.name: Fire reaches the urban fringe
scenarios.sa_impact: Emergency warnings for outer north-eastern suburbs.

actions.action: If you are in or near Williamstown, Kersbrook or Lyndoch, leave now if your plan says leave
actions.reason: On Catastrophic days the CFS says homes are not built to withstand fire; leaving early is the safest option.

actions.action: Keep away from the Hills and keep roads clear
actions.reason: Fire trucks need the roads, and conditions can change fast with the wind change.

concerns.title: SIMULATION: Power and phone outages in the Hills
drivers: SIMULATED: SA Power Networks has cut power to lines in the fire area; some mobile towers on battery backup.

scenarios.name: Outages limited to the fire area
scenarios.sa_impact: A few thousand homes without power for a day.

scenarios.name: Wider outages as more lines are cut
scenarios.sa_impact: Outages spreading into the northern Hills and Barossa.

actions.action: Charge phones and power banks now
actions.reason: Mobile towers in fire areas run on batteries that last hours, not days.
